settings.headline: Tell me about the land
settings.subtitle: This demo has no form that sends anywhere. In a real inquiry I ask for the five things below — copy them into an email to june@calloway.example (fictional, does not reach anyone).

settings.headline: The five things I need to know
settings.intro: If you don't know an answer yet, write 'don't know' — that is useful too.

items.b: Address or coordinates, and whether you own it. A photo facing west at sunset helps more than a drone video.
Your all-in number, including septic/water/power if the land is raw. I will tell you if the brief fits it.
Who lives there, and the smallest house that would work. Smaller is not settling here; it is the strategy.
When you want to sleep there, and what is driving that date.
What you have seen of mine that fits how you want to live.

settings.headline: What happens next
settings.body: I reply myself within three working days. If it fits, we schedule a land walk (phase 01). If it doesn't, I reply with why, and who might fit better. No newsletter, no sequence of follow-ups.
